name: Noran Black Felt
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual material illustration for the Avarenne novel encyclopedia. Main subject: Deep matte black wool felt roll with a thick cut edge exposing densely matted fibres, two layered felt swatches on a pale workshop board, side lighting makes the fuzzy non-woven texture readable. No woven silk, no black smoke, no supernatural void. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, exquisite tactile detail and believable natural material behaviour, late industrial craft atmosphere. Landscape 3:2. One coherent close-up scene of this ONE material, with raw or worked examples of that same material only where requested; not a composite board of different materials. Use light and background suited to this specific material so its texture, silhouette and colour are immediately legible. No people, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, logo, watermark, card frame or infographic. Do not add supernatural effects to ordinary material. No extra tools or props that could be mistaken for a different catalogue specimen.
visual_caption: Campione illustrativo di Noran Black Felt. Forma, colore e finitura aiutano a riconoscere il materiale; non certificano da soli purezza, provenienza o investimento.
